name: Malden
_comment: No seed_network is shipped: the repo carries no network data. A deployment that wants to open on its existing conditions adds one here and drops the file beside it.
Which tiles to draw behind the map. This is configuration because a
provider can start requiring an API key - CARTO did, and a static app
has nowhere to put a private key.
openstreetmap.org's tiles are keyless and fine for local work and a
small deployment. Their tile usage policy DISCOURAGES heavy use,
though, so a public deployment with real traffic should serve its own
tiles - the same conclusion, and the same cheap static hosting, as the
roads tiles in V2_PLAN.md 8.2. Growth being a burden on a donated
public resource is a bug, not a success.
